{{Quote|As I stood there, decked out in my finest Sav'ruuchi pantsuit at the Xenvaer Civic Auditorium, staring at the flotsam swirl and collide in the juice punch, it occurred to me how very much like that watered down beverage bowl this party was.|Dyslogia Twang|<ref name="HNN53">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|life/13425_1.html|SPECIAL FEATURE: Sightings by Twang}}</ref>}}
A '''Sav'ruuchi pantsuit''' was a type of luxury [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] item. By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] journalist [[Dyslogia Twang]] was known to wear one on special occasions, such as the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]] fundraiser on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]].
